question: Which Indian state hosted the FIH Men’s Hockey World cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odisha** hosted the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2023.
 
• This prestigious event was held in the cities of **Bhubaneswar** and **Rourkela**.
 
• The state of Odisha has been a significant promoter of hockey in India and has also hosted the 2018 edition of the Men's Hockey World Cup.
 
• Odisha's commitment to sports, especially hockey, is evident through its state-of-the-art facilities and infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The FIH Men's Hockey World Cup is an international field hockey competition organized by the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• The tournament was first held in 1971 and is held every four years.
 
• India has won the Men's Hockey World Cup once, in 1975.
 
• Odisha, particularly Bhubaneswar, has become a global hub for hockey, hosting numerous international tournaments and matches.
 
• The Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar and the newly built Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium in Rourkela were the key venues for the 2023 event.
